Hello! I'd be happy to help you determine if you're eligible for Child Benefit. To assess your eligibility, I'll need to ask you some questions.

First, let me read the official guidance to ensure I provide you with accurate information.

conversation.text:

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Thank you for that information. I'll need to ask you some questions about each of your three children - Alex, Blake, and Charlie - to determine your eligibility for Child Benefit.

Let's start with Alex. How old is Alex?

conversation.text:
I understand that residency situations can be complicated. To help assess your eligibility, I need to understand your situation a bit better.

Are you currently physically living in the UK, or are you living in another country?

Without needing to define your exact residency status, can you tell me: Are any of your children - Alex, Blake, or Charlie - currently in hospital for an extended period, in care, or living with someone else? Or do they all live with you full-time at your home?

conversation.text: Well, actually, Blake has been in hospital for a few months now - it's been quite a difficult time. And I'm fostering Charlie. But Alex lives with me full-time at home.

conversation.text:
I'm sorry to hear about Blake being in hospital - that must be very difficult for you and your family.

Let me ask some follow-up questions to understand your situation better.

Starting with Blake who's in hospital: How many weeks has Blake been in hospital?

conversation.text: It's been about 18 weeks now.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text: Thank you for that information. Since Blake has been in hospital for 18 weeks (which is more than 12 weeks), I need to ask: Do you regularly spend money on Blake - for example, on clothes, toys, treats, or other items for them?

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Yes, I do. I still buy things for Blake - clothes, magazines, their favorite snacks when I visit. I try to keep up with what they need even though they're in the hospital.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text: That's good to know. Now, regarding Charlie who you mentioned you're fostering: Is your local council paying anything towards Charlie's accommodation or maintenance?

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: No, the council isn't paying me anything for fostering Charlie.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Thank you for clarifying that. Now I need to understand your residency situation a bit more to complete the assessment, as it's one of the key eligibility criteria.

You mentioned earlier that your residency status is uncertain. Can you tell me: Are you currently physically present and living in the UK with your children, or are you living abroad? Even if your status is complicated, knowing where you're physically located will help me assess your eligibility.
